record.question: Yahoo, an American web services company is owned by
record.explanation: Answer A: Verizon. Verizon completed its acquisition of Yahoo’s operating business in 2017; in 2019 Yahoo’s online services belonged to Verizon Media. The simple corporate ownership wording is dated and should name the operating business. Reference: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1011006/000089882216000405/press_release.htm; https://www.altaba.com/press-releases/yahoo-completes-sale-operating-business-company-to-be-re-named/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
